validation.interpretation: Same four geographic outer folds and buffer as the regional peers. Entire posterior is refitted with fixed generic priors using training observations only. No response-based inner tuning is used. Heldout observation prediction does not validate total volume in unobserved regions.

mass_partition.interpretation: Geometry-screened fractions, not fractions validated by data. Quantiles of parts do not add to quantiles of the total. Sobol integration error is separate from posterior uncertainty.

reproducibility.normalization: Whole WGS84 Earth, analytical per-fan normalizers; total mass is the volume parameter. No integration bounds or isopach cutoff enter inference.
